title: How a Dishwasher Works in 60 Seconds 🍽️💦 #shorts
description:
A dishwasher doesn't fill up like a bathtub. It heats a small pool of water, pumps it through spinning spray arms, filters it and sprays it again and again, so a modern machine can clean a full load with as little as 3 gallons. Fill, spray, filter, rinse. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#dishwasher #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: The Hook
steps.text: A modern dishwasher can clean a full load with as little as *3 gallons* of water. Washing by hand can take up to 27.

steps.label: Fill & Heat
steps.text: Only a small pool of water fills the bottom, and a *heater* warms it up.

steps.label: Spray Arms
steps.text: A *pump* pushes that water into the spray arms. The jets themselves make the arms *spin*.

steps.label: Detergent
steps.text: The *detergent* door pops open, and the soapy spray breaks down grease and food.

steps.label: Recycle
steps.text: Water drains through a *filter*, then gets pumped up and sprayed again, over and over.

steps.label: Rinse & Dry
steps.text: Clean water *rinses* the dishes, and heat helps them dry.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Fill, spray, filter, *rinse*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
